'''Anri Katsu''' (Japanese: '''勝杏里''' ''Katsu Anri'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Katsu was born on July 3, 1977, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|AG}}, but his best-known role in that work was {{an|Tierno}}, one of {{Ash}}'s [[rival]] in the [[Kalos]] [[region]], which he played during the {{aniseries|XY|''XY'' series}}. Katsu is currently affiliated with the talent agency Ken Production.
